entries.rationale: The raw-copy extension list no longer includes fopts because particle sources now have a dedicated compile step. The font contract changes only because it records that shared raw-copy boundary.
entries.migration: No font migration is required. Particle projects must rename authored .fopts files to .spark, reference baked .spk resources, enable FO_SPARK_PARTICLES, and perform a full resource rebake.
entries.release_note: Record the raw-copy boundary correction in Docs/FontFormat.md and link the particle migration in Docs/ParticleFormat.md for this Engine revision.
entries.compatibility: Font descriptors and runtime font data are unchanged. Old .fopts delivery is intentionally incompatible and must move with the particle baker/runtime revision.
